findings.summary: Four of five guided responses violated the hard 1200-word cap while every control conformed, yet the canonical paired microtest was accepted at a 0.48 delta.
findings.effect: The canonical paired microtest is not valid confirmatory acceptance evidence.

findings.summary: The frozen design required two blind scorers, but only one blind score is recorded and the independent auditor read the arm mapping.
findings.effect: The zero-bit-change audit is not the second blind score promised by the protocol.

findings.summary: Held-out attempt 005 required 5/5 but scored 4/5 and records accepted false.
findings.effect: The verified milestone and no-blockers language overstate acceptance unless held-out evidence is explicitly non-gating.

findings.summary: Attempt 005 has no generation plan, generation attestation, or response-freeze manifest supporting the frozen execution protocol.
findings.effect: Freshness, generator/scorer separation, freeze chronology, and no-repair/no-resampling are not reconstructable.

findings.summary: The manifest declares a prefix wrapper, but Case ID and Reviewer ID are appended to canonical forward responses.
findings.effect: Metadata drift only; current full-file hashes match.

findings.summary: The baseline independent review labels the generation-freeze-manifest hash as manifest_sha256.
findings.effect: The freeze artifact remains hash-valid, but the label does not identify the current baseline manifest.

pending_remediation: Run a conforming canonical paired microtest under the frozen cap and scoring protocol.
Resolve the failed held-out gate or explicitly document held-out evidence as non-gating.
Add reconstructable held-out execution attestations for freshness, independence, freeze chronology, and no repair or resampling.
